title: 第1116 章 进去玩一把第1115 章 瞧不起
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 时间过得很快，一眨眼半个月过去。
这半个月来，秦关一直在鸿蒙塔一楼参悟鸿蒙天地法理。
越是参悟金色光幕上的道纹，秦关心里就越是震惊痴迷。
他发现只要悟透一个道纹，道纹内蕴含的强大力量法则就会注入进自己的神性大道碑，然后将原本对应的力量符文反复打磨，最后完善强化的特别圆润通畅。
半个月的时间，以秦关对天地大道的理解，也不过才悟透了七道道纹。
但仅仅是七个道纹，就让他受益匪浅，神性之力得到了不小的强化。
“果然够深奥，半个月才参悟了七个道纹。”
金色光幕前，秦关突然站起身，用力的伸了个懒腰。
听到秦关的话，不远处一名中年男子心中顿时一惊，惊疑不定的看向秦关。
秦关看向四周，发现此刻金色光幕下，就剩下他和不远处一名中年男子，其他人全都不在这里。
“小子，刚才你说你已经悟透了七个道纹？”
这时，那名中年男子突然笑着来到秦关这边。
秦关看向中年男子点头笑道：“是啊，我半个月才悟了七道，感觉好难啊！”
中年男子笑意一滞，目光在秦关脸上停了一瞬，像是在确认他是不是在开玩笑。
过了片刻后他才开口：“半个月悟了七道，你知道我们这些人在这里参悟了多久吗？”
秦关听后摇了摇头：“不知道。”
中年男子看向金色光幕正色道：
“我们三百多人在这里已经参悟了三年多，天资最好的那位也不过悟了十八道，你半个月就悟了七道，这个速度已经很变态了。”
秦关听后神色一怔，没想到这帮人在这里参悟了三年，最快的才悟了十八个道纹。
“这光幕上有一百个道纹，越往后越复杂难懂，可能前面的比较简单吧，第八个我悟了好久都没有摸到门路。”
听到秦关的话，中年男子摆了摆手：
“不必谦虚，你半个月就走到这一步，说明你对天地大道法理的理解本就不浅，这光幕上的道纹，只是帮你把已有的东西重新梳理了一遍。”
秦关若有所思地点了点头，确实如这人所说，目前自己领悟的七个道纹，的确是在完善强化他原本就有的东西。
“敢问小兄弟，你可是通过万妖塔试炼秘境来到这里的？”
这时，中年男子突然好奇问。
秦关既不是儒门的，也不是天命神殿的，其他势力弟子唯一能来到这里的通道只有万妖塔秘境试炼。
秦关点头回道：“我是通过万妖塔试炼进来的。”
得到确定，中年男子了然：“难怪你有如此天赋，那个秘境可不是一般人能通过的，你是我见过的唯一一个。”
秦关淡淡一笑：“误打误撞，侥幸通过而已。”
“敢问小兄弟是下界哪个势力的，没想到下界还有如此天赋异禀之人。”中年男子又好奇问。
秦关没有隐瞒：“在下是神剑宗的弟子。”
“神剑宗……”
中年男子嘴里重复了下，像是搜索记忆里的信息：“下界确实有这么个宗门。”
在他印象里，神剑宗不算大，但也不算太小，是一个中流正统剑宗。
“在下叫顾明远，是南极大陆儒门弟子，小兄弟若是有兴趣，日后可来儒门做客。”
听到顾明远的话，秦关态度恭敬，对着他深深一礼：
content_en:
Time flies so fast, half a month passes in the blink of an eye.
In the past half month, Qin Guan has been studying the principles of Hongmeng Heaven and Earth on the first floor of Hongmeng Tower.
The more he understood the Dao patterns on the golden light screen, the more shocked and obsessed Qin Zhanli became.
He discovered that as long as he understood a Dao pattern, the powerful power laws contained in the Dao pattern would be injected into his divine avenue monument, and then the original corresponding power runes would be polished repeatedly, and finally perfected and strengthened to become particularly round and smooth.
In half a month, with Qin Guan's understanding of the great avenues of heaven and earth, he could only comprehend the seven patterns.
But just seven Dao patterns have benefited him a lot, and his divine power has been greatly strengthened.
"It is indeed profound enough. It took me half a month to comprehend the seven Dao patterns."
In front of the golden light curtain, Qin Guan suddenly stood up and stretched hard.
Hearing Qin Guan's words, a middle-aged man not far away was suddenly startled and looked at Qin Guan in confusion.
"Huh?"
Qin Guan looked around and found that under the golden light curtain, he and a middle-aged man not far away were the only ones left, and no one else was here.
"Boy, just now you said that you have understood the Seven Dao Marks?"
At this time, the middle-aged man suddenly came to Qinguan with a smile.
Qin Guan looked at the middle-aged man, nodded and smiled: "Yes, it took me half a month to realize the Seven Paths. It feels so difficult!"
The middle-aged man's smile faltered, and his eyes paused on Qin Guan's face for a moment, as if to confirm whether he was joking.
After a while, he spoke: "It took me half a month to realize the Seven Paths. Do you know how long we people have been here to realize it?"
Qin Guan shook his head after hearing this: "I don't know."
The middle-aged man looked at the golden light screen and said seriously:
"More than three hundred of us have been here for more than three years. The most talented person has only enlightened eighteen ways. You have enlightened seven ways in half a month. This speed is already abnormal."
Qin Guan looked startled after hearing this. He didn't expect that this group of people had been meditating here for three years, and they were the fastest to understand the eighteen Tao patterns.
"There are a hundred Dao patterns on this light screen. The further back they get, the more complex and difficult they are to understand. Maybe the ones in front are simpler. I have understood the eighth one for a long time but I still haven't found the way."
After hearing Qin Guan's words, the middle-aged man waved his hand:
"There is no need to be modest. You have reached this point in half a month, which shows that your understanding of the principles of the heaven and earth is not shallow. The patterns on this light curtain just help you reorganize what you already have."
Qin Guan nodded thoughtfully. It was indeed as the man said. The seven Dao patterns he had comprehended so far were indeed perfecting and strengthening what he already had.
"I dare to ask little brother, did you come here through the secret trial realm of Ten Thousand Demons Tower?"
At this time, the middle-aged man suddenly asked curiously.
Qinguan does not belong to the Confucian sect, nor does it belong to the Temple of Destiny. The only way for disciples from other forces to come here is through the secret trial of the Ten Thousand Demons Tower.
Qin Guan nodded and replied: "I came in through the trial of the Ten Thousand Demons Tower."
After being confirmed, the middle-aged man understood: "No wonder you have such a talent. That secret realm is not something that ordinary people can pass. You are the only one I have ever seen."
Qin Guan smiled faintly: "I bumped into it by mistake, I just got through by luck."
"Dare I ask which force in the lower realm my little brother belongs to? I didn't expect there to be such talented people in the lower realm." The middle-aged man asked curiously.
Qin Guan did not hide anything: "I am a disciple of the Divine Sword Sect."
"Sword Sword Sect..."
The middle-aged man repeated, as if searching for information in his memory: "There is indeed such a sect in the lower world."
In his impression, the Divine Sword Sect was not too big, but not too small either. It was a mid-level orthodox Sword Sect.
"My name is Gu Mingyuan, and I am a disciple of the Confucian sect in Antarctica. If you are interested, little brother, you can come to the Confucian sect as a guest in the future."
After hearing Gu Mingyuan's words, Qin Guan treated him respectfully and bowed deeply to him:
